file.string: This app helps you monitor your health by analyzing the color of the fake nail’s biosensor.
Ready to begin? Click the button below to start the health check now!
Your saliva is more acidic than the typical healthy range. This can occur temporarily due to recent food or drink, dehydration, stress, or acid reflux.
Choose a color using the interactive picker. Copy the HEX or RGB value and enter it below.

• Rinse & Retest: Rinse your mouth with water and retest in
	 30–60 minutes, avoiding food or acidic drinks beforehand.
 • Hydrate: Drinking water helps restore saliva’s natural buffering
	 ability.
 • Notice Patterns: Frequent low pH readings may be associated
	 with acid reflux, dry mouth, or dietary habits.
 • Seek Care if Persistent: Frequent acidity may increase the risk
	 of enamel erosion and oral discomfort; consider consulting a
	 dentist or healthcare provider if you experience persistent
	 acidic readings, tooth sensitivity, or heartburn.
Are you sure you want to log out?
Disclaimer: This is not a medical diagnosis. For an accurate assessment, please consult a licensed healthcare professional.
Every weekend there is a decrease in your pH levels:
Lower saliva pH on weekends may occur due to changes in routine, such as diet, alcohol intake, sleep patterns, or acid reflux.
